thread:
Aria: FYI scheduling a midnight tilt for router pin -> v3.2.1 at 00:00 UTC. Objective: warm KV cache, then micro-tilt 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Keep 5m holds. Rollback window 25m. Can @Noah @Priya assist?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: booking window 00:00-02:00 UTC. Runbook snippet: `deployctl pin router --model v3.2.1 --mode tilt` Dry-run passed.

Noah: I'll start warmup + watch latency. Will ping when canary is live.

Priya: I'll monitor errors and traces. Prep fallback: v3.1.9-compact.

Aria: Rollback criteria: +1% errors absolute OR p95 +160ms beyond baseline OR host p99 > 1.2s. Hold between steps 5m.

deploy-bot: DRY RUN OK. Add release tag `tilt-midnight` and notes URL: https://releases.internal/6765

Noah: kicking warmup: `internal-warmup --model v3.2.1 --samples 800` logs: `warmed=180/800` ETA 2m.

Aria: Canary go in 30s. Keep LB drain timeout at 45s.

(deploy-bot system): `deployctl apply --dry-run`
CONFIG OK: cohorts: canary=2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%

Noah: Canary live at 2%. Initial p95=200ms, errors +0.02% -> OK to proceed to 15%.

Priya: moving to 15% now. Pausing 5m. Watching error budget and traces.

Noah: small tail on host-az1-09 p99=920ms, correlates with long GC pause. Tagging host for drain: `routerctl drain host-az1-09`.

Aria: Pause ramps. If we see the same tail on another host, we rollback.

Priya: host drained, p99 back to 430ms cluster. No spike in 5xx.

Noah: resuming to 60%.

deploy-bot: telemetry snapshot: p95 delta=+28ms, errors +0.18% 98 within thresholds.

Aria: Proceeding to 100% but keep 15m watch and oncall on standby.

oncall-kyla: Oncall ACK. Rollback command staged: `deployctl unpin router --model v3.1.9-compact`. Prepped CB: `routerctl set-cb 1.6`.

Priya: 100% complete. Observability: p95=235ms p99=450ms errors +0.2%. Updating release notes: "tilt applied; single-host GC tail mitigated by drain."

Noah: Leaving pin for 6h as usual. Will run a post-rollout scan at +1h and +3h.

Aria: Thanks all. Close after notes + short postmortem snippet added. :tada:
